text: A psalm of Asaph. I God takes a stand in the divine council,gives judgment in the midst of the gods. [AA]
"How long will you judge unjustlyand favor the cause of the wicked? [AB]Selah
"Defend the lowly and fatherless;render justice to the afflicted and needy.
Rescue the lowly and poor;deliver them from the hand of the wicked." [AC]
II [1]The gods neither know nor understand,wandering about in darkness,and all the world's foundations shake.
I declare: "Gods though you be, [2] [AD]offspring of the Most High all of you,
Yet like any mortal you shall die;like any prince you shall fall."
Arise, O God, judge the earth, [3]for yours are all the nations.
